doc: COMPRESSOR_RESEARCH.md (source keys S1..S33 are listed in section 7)

generic_model.gain_computer: soft-knee Eq.4: y=x if 2(x-T)<-W; x+(1/R-1)(x-T+W/2)^2/(2W) if |2(x-T)|<=W; T+(x-T)/R above. Optional second segment: ratio2 above knee2_db over threshold.
generic_model.detector_default: log-domain, after gain computer (Eq.23), smooth decoupled peak (Eq.17); alpha=exp(-1/(tau*fs))

release_models.dual_stage: two branches on same target: fast(tauA,tauR_fast), slow(tau_charge,tauR_slow); combine max() or weighted w*fast+(1-w)*slow [S16]
release_models.constant_rate: release ramps at rate_db_per_s in dB (dbx) [S17,S18]
release_models.opto_memory: dual_stage weighted w=0.5 where tauR_slow = slow_min_s + M*(slow_max_s-slow_min_s); M charges from sustained GR with tau_mem_s
release_models.rc_network: simulate the unit's actual release RC network as coupled one-pole states in 'detector volts', then map volts->GR with the unit's gain-element law (Fairchild, SSL). Exact for linear networks; costs 2-3 multiplies per state per sample.
release_models.series_two_section: SSL Auto: two parallel-RC sections in series. Charging current i flows through both: dv1/dt=i/C1 - v1/(R1 C1); dv2/dt=i/C2 - v2/(R2 C2); control = v1+v2. Release = a1 e^-t/tau1 + a2 e^-t/tau2 exactly.

generic_model.bloom_law: wet_gain_dB = clamp(Amount_dB + GR_dB, -MaxDuck_dB, +Amount_dB); applied to tail only; detector on dry (or dry+wet in self-keyed mode); per-sample detector; Amount=0 => bit-identical bypass

timing_definitions_rule.value: Fairchild and SSL panel release times ~= time to recover from ~10 dB GR to ~0.5-1 dB, i.e. ~2.1-2.5 x the RC time constant; not tau

bloom_presets.name: Natural

sidechain_filter.note: LA-2A has optional HF-emphasis; off by default

knee_db.note: compression 'gradually increases over the first 10 dB' then horizontal

attack_ms.note: 1966 manual 10 us conflict; SPICE closed loop of fitted cell gives 63% in ~20 ms; Moore 2025 measured 33-81 ms to stabilise on 6 real LA-2As

release.form: tau_rel = r0 + (r1-r0)*M2; M1,M2 cascaded lags (tm) charging while light is on, decaying with tm_decay when dark; applied to LDR conductance G; GR_dB = 20*log10(1+Rs*G)

r0_s.note: short-peak floor; matches UA 60 ms-to-50% (tau 87 ms) and Stroe 90 ms after 300 ms burst

r1_s.note: fit to Stroe Table 6.6 CdS+Old-Modelled cell: 0.09/0.58/1.56 s after 0.3/1/5 s bursts (resid <= 47 ms)

tm_decay_s.note: Lawrence 1964 via Stroe: cell remembers GR from the last 20-30 s

spice_check.value: closed-loop release G-tau 0.14/0.57/1.51 s for 0.3/1/5 s bursts; 5 s burst recovers to 0.5 dB in 4.8 s (spec 0.5-5 s)

bloom_presets.confidence_note: memory law now fitted to measured optical-cell data; LA-2A unit spread is large (release 0.45-1.67 s to stabilise across 6 units)

a2_s.note: open-loop cell values; feedback loop makes the audible attack ~5x faster

gain_element.value: CdS LDR shunt attenuator: G = k*L^gamma, gamma 0.6 (0.6-0.85)

static_ratio.value: soft knee, local ratio rises 1.1 -> asymptote 1+gamma*n (2.8 with defaults); UA quotes ~4:1 so tune n*gamma ~3

detector.value: no rectifier/RC: the EL panel + LDR are the detector (light-domain averaging)

bloom_presets.name: Glue

detector.value: full-wave rectifier -> diode -> attack R -> cap (peak-hold, linear volts, not RMS, not log)

sidechain_filter.note: Waves adds 21-500 Hz HPF; not confirmed on hardware

knee_db.note: hard onset at the rectifier diode; softness comes from the rising ratio instead

attack_ms.note: RC = 82k*0.47uF = 38.5 ms; feedback shortens it: SPICE 63% = 26.7/14.5/9.4 ms at 4/8/13 dB GR (4:1). Labels hold at ~12 dB GR; slower at light GR, faster at heavy GR

tau_fast_ms.note: 91k || 0.47uF; values confirmed on a 1979 original card (GroupDIY)

w_slow_vs_burst.note: SPICE fit: 0.11/0.36/0.69/0.86/0.88 for 0.05/0.3/1/3/8 s bursts; two-exponential fit error 0.035 dB

release.superseded: old estimate fast 100 ms / charge 300 ms / slow 1200 ms (max)

alt_clone.value: GSSL / gyraf clone swaps the resistors: 0.35 s and 0.62 s (much less program-dependent)

bloom_presets.confidence_note: timing parts read from the original drawings and confirmed on a real card; VCA scale assumed

fixed_release_tau_ms.note: labels ~= time from 8-10 dB to 1 dB (SPICE: 0.17/0.26/0.55/1.18 s)

ratio_vs_gr.value: local ratio ~= R0 + 0.115*GR_dB (feedback + linear detector + dB-linear VCA); SPICE 4:1 gives 3.9 -> 4.4 over 4-13 dB GR
ratio_vs_gr.note: KDB scale assumed; trend robust, exact slope not

topology_original.value: feedback via sidechain VCA mirroring the main VCA

ratio.note: all-buttons ratio ~12-20 and varying; add +-4 slow drift

attack_ms.note: labels describe the start of the gain change. Circuit RC = up to 25k*220nF = 5.5 ms; KT clone measured ~0.5 ms to 37% but ~5 ms to full (GroupDIY). SPICE: 63% in 0.16 ms (8 dB GR) / 0.09 ms (16 dB GR) at fastest; 1.2 / 0.7 ms at slowest

attack_onset_lag_ms.note: mechanism (jhaible PSpice study): all-buttons shorts part of the bias divider, pushing the FET past pinch-off so the cap must charge through a dead zone before GR starts; lag grows with slower attack settings and lighter drive. Our SPICE shows only tens of us at fastest attack, so 2 ms stays an estimate

tauR_ms.note: range 59-1160 ms = (270k + 0..5M pot)*220nF (circuit-derived, matches manual 63% spec); 300 ms suits medium tempo

attack_settle_ms.note: second, slower stage of attack to full GR (0.5-5.5 ms); new field

gain_element.value: JFET shunt: Rds ~ Ron/(1-Vgs/Vp) (2N5457 Ron 273 ohm, 2N3819 130 ohm, vendor models); max GR ~30 dB

detector.value: full-wave peak rectifier with ratio-dependent bias + feedback gain (ratio buttons change both)

level_dependent_times.value: attack and release speed up as GR increases (FET slope changes loop gain)
